# Limbs A body has 11 parts. Each one hangs off another: hands off the arms, feet off the legs, legs off the groin, and arms, head and groin off the torso.
## Reattaching a severed limb You operate on the part the limb hangs off. A torn-off arm goes back on the [color=#a4885c]torso[/color], and a leg on the [color=#a4885c]groin[/color]. On the doll, click the missing limb and the window takes you there.
1. [color=#a4885c]Stop Bleeding[/color] if the stump is still bleeding.
2. [color=#a4885c]Fix Dismemberment Leftovers[/color] to clean up the stump.
3. [color=#a4885c]Attach[/color] the limb, for example Attach Left Arm, while holding the limb or keeping it next to you. The last step seals the wound.
## Amputating [color=#a4885c]Amputate[/color] removes a limb without hurting the patient. It's under Other procedures on every limb, and the plan never suggests it.
